summary: Yatsen Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with its press release announcing second-quarter 2026 financial results. Net revenues rose 5.1% year-over-year to RMB1.14 billion; skincare brands grew 40.4% to RMB816.1 million, now 71.5% of total revenue. Net loss widened to RMB90.8 million from RMB19.5 million. Management comments on restructuring the color cosmetics portfolio and focusing on skincare, but no specific transaction, tender offer, divestiture, or strategic review is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
